capabilities: Convert wiki links and aliases to Markdown links
Copy embedded images to the Hugo static directory and rewrite embeds
Auto-write YAML headers with title, date and lastmod
Sync tagged notes via a button or the Hugo Publish: Sync blog command
disambiguation: Not Obsidian Publish; it exports notes to a self-hosted Hugo static site instead.
extras: User must run hugo server manually in the site directory to preview; settings require configuring a blog tag and Hugo site path.
problem: Obsidian's wiki links, image embeds and missing YAML headers are not directly usable when publishing notes with the Hugo static site generator.

relations.evidence: This plugin will convert the .md file and related images in obsidian to the hugo site dir.

summary: Converts Obsidian notes with wiki links and image embeds into Hugo-compatible Markdown inside a Hugo site directory.
